Title: Sr. Data Scientist, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the development, validation, and governance of the full suite of risk models for a high-growth payment product in Mexico, directly shaping the analytical foundation that drives every business decision across the product lifecycle. If you thrive on building scorecards from the ground up — starting with external data and expert-rule frameworks when proprietary data does not yet exist, then architecting the transition to custom models as portfolio mature — this is your opportunity to establish and scale a risk modeling function from inception. As Sr. Data Scientist, you will own the end-to-end model roadmap spanning origination, behavioral, delinquency propensity, collections, recovery, analytical fraud, and reserve input models. You will define development standards, documentation practices, versioning protocols, and monitoring frameworks with the rigor required to withstand audit scrutiny and regulatory review. Your work is both tactical and strategic: you will manage complex, cross-functional model programs with negotiated and defined obligations, influencing roadmaps, business and technology decisions, and model governance across the organization. Success in this role is measured by discriminatory power (KS, Gini) and its stability over time, Population Stability Index (PSI) of variables and scores, development-to-implementation cycle time, and the absence of validation findings. In a new product, the first 12 to 18 months are typically operated with generic or bureau scorecards and expert rules; this role requires someone who knows how to launch without proprietary data and plan the deliberate transition to custom models built on proprietary performance data as vintages mature. Key job responsibilities You will own and execute the model roadmap covering origination scorecards, behavioral scorecards, delinquency propensity models, collections and recovery models, analytical fraud models, and reserve inputs (PD, LGD, EAD). You will manage the full model lifecycle: development, validation, approval, implementation, ongoing monitoring, recalibration, and retirement. You will develop the origination scorecard, including reject inference methodology, and lead feature engineering across external data sources, and partner transactional data. You will build behavioral scorecards,payment propensity, contactability, and recovery models and produce PD, LGD, and EAD inputs for reserves calculation. You will own model validation end-to-end: conducting conceptual soundness reviews, replicating results, performing stress testing and stability analysis, and issuing formal opinions with findings, severity classifications, and remediation timelines. You will produce complete technical documentation and model files to the standard required for third-party review. A day in the life You will join working sessions with the risk team to translate champion/challenger experiment results into model refinement priorities, and calibrate payment propensity and contactability models against real-world recovery outcomes. You will coordinate with engineering to validate that deployed model versions match approved specifications and prepare the model performance package for the credit and risk committees. About The Team We are a team at Amazon building a new business, and we sit within the Payments organization. Today the team is small by design, which means you will have an outsized role in shaping our credit risk function, processes, and culture from day one. Our closest partners span finance, technology, and commercial teams, and together we are investing in creating a world-class underwriting and credit risk capability. If you want to help define something new at Amazon and see your work directly reflected in the product, we would love to hear from you. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience 4+ years of data scientist experience Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience Experience managing data pipelines Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Data Scientist - Automated Valuation Models (AVM)
Description: Qué estamos buscando? Buscamos un/a profesional con sólida formación cuantitativa, actuarial o matemática, apasionado/a por la ciencia de datos y el modelado predictivo, para incorporarse a la Unidad Técnica dentro de la Dirección General de Riesgos. El objetivo central de la posición es diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar modelos estadísticos predictivos y algoritmos de inteligencia artificial aplicados a la valuación de garantías inmobiliarias, permitiendo contrastar de manera rigurosa las valoraciones de mercado y robustecer la mitigación del riesgo crediticio de la institución. Principales responsabilidades Desarrollar, calibrar y optimizar modelos estadísticos predictivos y de inteligencia artificial orientados a la estimación y validación del valor de garantías inmobiliarias. Diseñar e implementar el Modelo Automatizado de Valuación (AVM - Automated Valuation Model ) del banco. Contrastar y auditar cuantitativamente los valores comerciales y avalúos emitidos por proveedores externos frente a las estimaciones de los modelos analíticos internos. Explotar y analizar bases de datos de alta escala (35,000 a 40,000 avalúos anuales) para identificar desviaciones por sobrevaluación o subvaluación, mitigando el riesgo de crédito. Brindar soporte técnico y analítico en casos especiales, garantías atípicas o transacciones corporativas de alta complejidad. Participar con voz y voto técnico en comités de avalúos, sustentando posturas a través del análisis de datos. Retos del puesto El principal desafío de esta posición consiste en liderar la conceptualización, desarrollo e integración técnica del Modelo Automatizado de Valuación (AVM), combinando técnicas avanzadas de Machine Learning y analítica predictiva con la rigurosidad normativa bancaria, logrando contrastar con precisión el volumen operativo anual y reduciendo significativamente la exposición al riesgo por fluctuaciones en el valor de las garantías. Los requisitos que debes cumplir son los siguientes: Conocimientos obligatorios: Dominio avanzado de Python para análisis de datos, estadística y desarrollo de modelos predictivos. Conocimientos profundos en estadística aplicada, modelado matemático y análisis. Manejo y consulta de bases de datos estructuradas y relacionales (SQL). Conocimientos deseables: Experiencia en técnicas de Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas al sector financiero Nociones o experiencia en valuación inmobiliaria, análisis de garantías o normatividad bancaria de avalúos. Estudios de posgrado en Ciencia de Datos, Finanzas Cuantitativas, Estadística o Valuación. Escolaridad: Licenciatura concluida en Actuaría, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Ciencia de Datos, Estadística, Ingeniería en Inteligencia Artificial, Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería Industrial o Arquitectura con perfil cuantitativo. Experiencia: Experiencia comprobable en modelado cuantitativo, análisis predictivo y procesamiento de bases de datos. Competencias: Pensamos en Grande Emprendimiento Decisiones basadas en datos Si te encuentras interesado/a, postúlate dando clic en “Solicitar”. No olvides adjuntar tu CV actualizado.

Data quality is a strategic priority for Prolific, so this is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior stakeholders. This isn't a traditional QA role. We are not looking for someone to review data against a predefined checklist. We are looking for an innovative thinker that can leverage their expertise to define what good means where no definition exists yet. Acting as a strategic thought partner, you’ll work at the intersection of human data, machine learning, evaluation across frontier use-cases that define what high-quality human data looks like for the next generation of advanced AI. This means that much of the work involves novel problems with no established answer, so you’ll be comfortable working through ambiguity.. . Your primary focus is working directly with clients and alongside frontier AI labs, translating what their models need into robust human data and evaluation strategies. Rather than checking quality at the end of a project, you'll engineer quality into every stage of the lifecycle, from study design and participant strategy through to evaluation, launch readiness and client delivery.You will also work alongside our product engineering, and supply teams to define and build the quality infrastructure that will enable us to deliver high quality human data at scale. Much of the work you'll tackle won't have an existing playbook. You'll help create it. What You’ll Be Doing Design the quality frameworks that underpin complex human data programmes, from evaluation rubrics through to launch readiness. Work with clients as a strategic thought partner, challenging annotation schemas and data requirements when they won't produce the signal the model needs. Advise on project design and how the choice of schema can impact data quality. Build quality upstream across the operational workflow, from recruitment, screening, and training through to writing guidelines and running calibration sessions. Build scalable quality systems, measurement frameworks and automated checks using Python and SQL. Partner with product and engineering to build the quality infrastructure that delivers high-quality human data at scale. Investigate data quality and integrity issues, identifying root causes and turning insights into scalable improvements. Architect and build dashboards, monitoring and reporting that provide clear visibility into quality and operational performance. Raise the quality capability across the company, upskilling operations and acting as a thought mentor to junior analysts. Help define how Prolific approaches quality across new AI domains, shaping best practice as the team grows. What You’ll Bring to the Role 5+ years of experience in building quality, evaluation or annotation systems within AI, machine learning, LLMs or human data environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, with a passion for using data to solve complex quality problems. A solid understanding of machine learning pipelines and how human data impacts model performance. Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with experience designing scalable quality frameworks. The confidence and credibility to interact with stakeholders at frontier labs and act as a partner. The ability to leverage your experience and expertise to influence and guide stakeholders at every level, both client side and internally. in The ability to turn your own data analysis and quality methodology into requirements that product and engineering can build into systems. The ability to explain yout data analysis and findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, so they can act on them. A proactive, builder's mindset -you enjoy creating new systems, navigating ambiguity and improving how things work. Even Better if you have: Experience with LLM evaluation, RLHF, AI safety or red teaming. Experience translating vague model or evaluation goals into clear annotation specifications. Experience working with human annotation programmes or human data operations. Familiarity with calibration, inter-rater agreement, drift detection or other evaluation methodologies. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Experience with or exposure to data transformation and workflow tools such as dbt, including data-quality testing and validation. Experience building or maintaining dashboards and reports using visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. Familiarity with digital marketing, media, or advertising data and an interest in understanding how data supports marketing decision-making. Exposure to marketing measurement concepts such as media mix modeling, lift testing, incrementality testing, attribution, or experimentation. Ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot reporting issues, and work across teams to identify and resolve root causes. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintaining data quality, consistency, and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities while delivering accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills with the ability to document processes, explain analytical concepts, and provide support to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with Python or R for analysis, automation, or data workflows is a plus. Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, workflow automation, taxonomy management, or data quality monitoring is a plus. Experience working with marketing technology, ad tech, data clean rooms, or measurement platforms is a plus. A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value. Title: Ai Product Builder

Improvado gathers, organizes, and untangles marketing data to deliver instant insights through BI and AI, helping to eliminate complexity, delivering laser-focused insights to optimize budgets, enhance campaign efficiency and marketing ROI. About the role As an AI Product Builder you own one product area end to end. Which area depends on where we need you most, and the work is the same in all of them. Title: Program Manager Quick Commerce, Quick Commerce
